Update this standing weekly production digest to Week 9. This is the same document every week - edit it in place. Make exactly the changes below and nothing else. STEP 1 - STATUS LINE. The bold status line directly under the document title must read exactly: Week 9 · 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-08 · Phase: Vertical Slice Leave the smaller grey line beneath it unchanged. STEP 2 - ARCHIVE. The 'Archive' table's data rows must end up being EXACTLY these 8 rows, in exactly this order, top to bottom. Keep the table's header row and all of its formatting. Cells shown in quotes are literal - copy them exactly. Cells shown in angle brackets are for you to write. The rows, top to bottom, must be exactly: 'Week 8', 'Week 7', 'Week 6', 'Week 5', 'Week 4', 'Week 3', 'Week 2', 'Week 1'. The first cell of each of those rows must read exactly as quoted, INCLUDING the word 'Week' - write 'Week 3', never '3'. The column is headed 'Week'; that heading is not a substitute for the label. Row 'Week 8' is NEW. Its Dates cell is '2026-02-23 to 2026-03-01'. Its Shipped cell is your own summary, at most 20 words, of EXACTLY this text and nothing else in the document: "Vertical slice level greyboxed and playable start to finish; Combat prototype merged to main behind a feature flag". Its Risks carried cell is your own summary, at most 15 words, of exactly these risks: "Crash rate above the cert threshold; No accessibility sign-off for subtitle sizing". Summarise the quoted text only - other steps in this instruction change the document, and this row must describe Week 8, not the week replacing it. Every other row keeps its existing cell contents exactly as they are - do not rewrite, reword or re-summarise them. STEP 3 - 'What changed'. Replace the ENTIRE
    element in that section with exactly this HTML, character for character:
    • First playtest with eight external players (avg session 41 min)
    • Audio middleware spike finished; Wwise selected over FMOD
    • Grapple cooldown retuned from 8s to 5s after playtest data
    STEP 4 - 'What is at risk' table. Replace the ENTIRE contents of that table's with exactly these 4 rows, character for character. Keep the header row exactly as it is: Crash rate above the cert thresholdDev H.QAMediumsteadyNo accessibility sign-off for subtitle sizingAna F.DesignLowsteadyPublisher marketing beats not aligned with content lockMarcus O.ProductionHighsteadyStreaming budget overrun on the Drift BeltYuki T.EngineeringHighsteady STEP 5 - 'What is next'. Replace the ENTIRE
      element in that section with exactly this HTML, character for character:
      • Instrument the traversal funnel
      • Close the audio licence
      REPLACEMENT MEANS REPLACEMENT: where this instruction lists what a section must contain, the section must end up containing exactly that and nothing else. Delete what is not on the list rather than keeping it alongside. Preserve all existing formatting exactly: the document title, every section heading, table borders, header-row shading, alternating row colours, fonts, font sizes and colours. Do not restyle anything. Do not add, remove or rename any heading. Do not reorder the sections. Copy every quoted or listed value character for character. Do not add a full stop to a bullet that has none, and do not reword anything. STRUCTURAL RULE: both tables must remain elements with their header rows intact. Never replace a table with a single row, a div or a list. Never drop a table's header row.

Nebula Drift - Weekly Production Digest

Week 8 · 2026-02-23 to 2026-03-01 · Phase: Vertical Slice
Vantage Nine Studios · internal · standing document, edited in place every Monday

What changed

  • Vertical slice level greyboxed and playable start to finish
  • Combat prototype merged to main behind a feature flag

What is at risk

RiskOwnerArea SeverityTrend
Crash rate above the cert thresholdDev H.QAMediumsteady
No accessibility sign-off for subtitle sizingAna F.DesignLowsteady

What is next

  • Get the slice in front of the publisher
  • Second external playtest, 20 players

Archive

Newest first. Detail rows older than 8 weeks are folded into a single rolled-up row so this section stays readable at 52 weeks.

Week Dates Shipped Risks carried
Week 7 2026-02-16 to 2026-02-22 Grapple cooldown retuned, camera rig handed off, localisation stubbed for six languages, slice playable start to finish Controller boss tuning, save-game versioning, matchmaking above 5k CCU, second designer delay
Week 6 2026-02-09 to 2026-02-15 Engine 5.4 merged; build times down 31%; art style narrowed to two directions; Drift Belt nav-mesh; Salvage spreadsheet first pass. Boss difficulty untuned for controller; save-game format still unversioned.
Week 5 2026-02-02 to 2026-02-08 Audio depot migrated to Git LFS; Grapple traversal prototype playable end to end on test level Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; outsourced character art slipping two weeks.
Week 4 2026-01-26 to 2026-02-01 Drift Belt nav-mesh and Salvage economy spreadsheet first pass. Nav-mesh generation for the Drift Belt sector; First pass on the Salvage economy spreadsheet Boss encounter difficulty and outsourced character art slipping. Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; Outsourced character art slipping two weeks
Week 3 2026-01-19 to 2026-01-25 Core loop pitch deck signed off by publisher; engine upgrade merged; build times down 31%; art style narrowed; nav-mesh generated. Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; outsourced character art slipping two weeks. Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; outsourced character art slipping two weeks.
Week 2 2026-01-12 to 2026-01-18 Second combat designer hired, starts week 9; audio depot migrated to Git LFS; grapple traversal prototype playable on test level Save-game format unversioned; boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; outsourced character art slipping two weeks
Week 1 2026-01-05 to 2026-01-11 Art style exploration narrowed to two directions; nav-mesh generation for Drift Belt sector Save-game format still unversioned; boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; outsourced character art slipping two weeks.
